details.effect: At the start of your end phase, if your leader is [abysscraft], give your leader [defense]+4, draw 2 cards, then each opponent discards 2 cards and buries 2 followers.

issues: The start-of-end ability incorrectly adds a condition requiring this card to be in the EX area or a named follower to be on the field; the source text is unconditional apart from your leader being Abysscraft, so remove that `if` wrapper and encode the effect directly.
The effect text says "if your leader is [abysscraft]" but the parsed condition does not check leader class; replace the current condition with a class check for your leader being Abysscraft.

The current sequence is nested under an incorrect conditional; the actual effect should simply be: heal your leader 4, draw 2 cards, each opponent discards 2 cards, then each opponent buries 2 followers, gated only by your leader being Abysscraft.

details.effect: Select an enemy follower on the field. Engage it and draw a card. It doesn't refresh during its controller's next start phase.

effect.label: It doesn't refresh during its controller's next start phase

issues: The final clause is encoded incorrectly as `grantOnCardPlayed` with a `noop`; it should be part of the same target engagement effect using `engage` with `skipRefreshNextStart: true` on the selected enemy follower.
Remove the unimplemented `noop` placeholder and the unrelated `grantOnCardPlayed` wrapper; the spell should resolve as: engage target enemy follower with skip-refresh-next-start, then draw 1 card.
